title: Totally rusted in 3 years
text: Totally rusted in 3 years. I have emailed the manufacturer to see if they will uphold their promise of a lifetime rustproof warranty.  This was purchased by me in 2012 and the inside rod is totally rusted.  Only one person showers in that bathroom, its not like a big family bathes/showers everyday.  This is so disappointing.  It was difficult  to install in our tiled bathroom, drilling holes in ceramic tile is hard.  And now it is rusted and has to be replaced.  Try matching up those holes.  Its going to be fun.

The rod installs easily with the included screws and anchors for drywall mounting. Step-by-step instructions are included with every rod.
